title: Navimower Map Card 0.3.6

## Stable release

Navimower Map Card 0.3.6 promotes the tested 0.3.6 beta line through `0.3.6-beta23` to stable. There is no intentional runtime behavior change from beta23; this release changes stable release metadata/documentation only.

### Highlights

- **Multi-mower Site view** with integration-provided site transforms and mower-scoped controls, Schedule, zones, History/session identity and notification actions.
- **Map underlays** for OpenStreetMap, Estonia Ortofoto/Hübriid and authenticated Google Satellite using Navimower-owned provider reference frames and site origins.
- **Phased Map API loading** so base geometry and primary controls can render before optional current-cycle/History artifacts finish.
- **Backend-prepared current-cycle and History rendering** with Home Assistant-time-zone day selection, bounded caching/retries and stale-response protection.
- **Exact Gate-area polygons and visual editor** with mower-local coordinate safety in Single/Multi mower views, edge insertion, self-intersection protection, rename/delete and integration-owned persistence.
- **Presentation-only underlay calibration** for small East/North/Rotation corrections without modifying mower-local geometry or backend georeference state.
- **Frontend privacy/interoperability cleanup** clarifying that account credentials/session tokens and map-provider secrets remain backend-owned and are not Map Card configuration.

### Compatibility

- Existing card YAML/configuration remains compatible.
- Existing screenshots/images and Navimower branding remain unchanged.
- Navimower integration `0.4.4` is the matching stable backend release.
- No 0.3.6 beta needs to be installed before this stable release.
